meta.name: Khalbali Records
meta.description: After his rockstar best friend- Mauj is killed in a concert, Raghav Rai Singh leaves the legacy his father, Manavendra Rai Singh, has planned for him at Galaxy records and sets out on a journey to accomplish Mauj’s goal i.e. starting a new kind of record label called 'Khalbali Records' that puts artists first- setting the stage for an epic conflict with the entire music establishment.

videos.title: Qatal Zabaan
videos.overview: After a tragic incident, Raghav leaves the legacy his father, Manvendra Rai Singh, had planned for him at Galaxy Records and sets out on a journey to accomplish Mauj's goal.

videos.title: Laal Sawaari
videos.overview: Raghav struggles with Khalbali Records' newly acquired artist as the first song he wants to release is a direct diss track against Galaxy's Tashan. Ananya struggles as her loyalty is tested between Monali and Galaxy.

videos.title: Soche Ki Bandeya
videos.overview: Raghav must choose to take help from an untrusted saviour to let his singers perform at a huge MTV event. Tashan's arrival at the event exposes the volatility of Ananya's lies. An impromptu rap battle leads to dire consequences.

videos.title: Pyaar Besharam
videos.overview: Misunderstood by all for his actions, a vulnerable Raghav seeks guidance from Lekha. To win her trust he exhibits honesty publicly which could be perceived as an offence by MRS. In Mauj's memory Lekha gives Raghav a priceless surprise.

videos.title: Azaad Ho Gaya
videos.overview: Armed with Mauj's unfinished songs, Raghav teams up with Lekha to shape up team Khalbali with rejuvenated vigor. Meanwhile MRS tests Ananya as she thwarts Das Babu's audits and pits her against Khalbali, meaning her own brother.

videos.title: Bolo Na
videos.overview: A new obstacle stands in Team Khalbali's way when Galaxy issues a cease & desist against them for Mauj's songs. Lekha stumbles upon a familiar face singing in a dingy club when she scouts for new talent for Khalbali Records.

videos.title: Majbur Mazdur
videos.overview: Team Khalbali launches a full-blown attack on Galaxy using Monali's new song as a public accusation against Tashan. Ananya suffers the consequences of Raghav's rebellion as MRS mounts pressure on her to speak out against Monali.

videos.title: Tham Ja
videos.overview: Ananya finally reaps the fruit of her hard work with a little help from Raghav. Raghav and team Khalbali are devasted to find out about a betrayal from someone close to them.
